source: Davis M., Hoult N.A., Scott A. (2017) Distributed strain sensing to assess corroded RC beams. Engineering Structures 140:473-482. doi:10.1016/j.engstruct.2017.03.013
provenance: Green OA accepted manuscript (CC BY-NC-ND), Queen's University Scholaris. All values below are stated in Section 3.1/3.3 text or printed as dimension labels in Figure 1; none are eyeballed off a plot.

geometry_mm.note_sleeve: short sleeve stops 50 mm before support centre; long sleeve extends 150 mm past support centre. No corrosion occurred under the sleeves (Sec 3.1).

bottom.area_source: CSA G30.18 nominal for 20M; the paper does NOT state the bar area or diameter

reinforcement.E_s_source: NOT reported by the source; assumed 200 GPa

concrete.f_c_note: average compressive strength at time of testing

loading.arrangement: three-point bending, simply supported, point load at midspan

instrumentation.fibers: nylon + polyimide bonded to both 20M bottom bars and one top 10M bar with cyanoacrylate (Loctite 4851), epoxy overcoat leaving ~70% of bar circumference exposed to corrode; 3 external nylon fibres on one side face

tabulated_strain: NONE. All strain data appear only as raster plots (Figures 5-10). PDF pages 17-20 contain embedded bitmap images plus caption text; there is no vector or tabulated strain anywhere in the article.

author_stated_strain_derived_events.note: 137 kN is a recorded FOS load stage; 'approximately 140 kN' is the authors' read of the load-deflection knee. Both are author-stated in text, not digitised here.
